Name: DE-PaymentConditions
Statement:
select  pyc.Oid as PaymentConditionId,
        pyc.Name as PaymentCondition,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        pyc.Active as IsActive,
        pyc.Days,
        pyc.HasTax,
        pyc.ClientDirect,
        pyc.Discount,
        pyc.ExternalId,
        pyc.AgencyCommissionHasTax
from    PaymentCondition pyc 
            join Company com on com.Oid = pyc.Company
